informal_statement: The selected inverse angle lies in (0,pi) for positive input.
reason: Equivalent in the declared constructor/section context. At MorgansArcFunction.lean:250-253, the source contract is `lemma θOf_mem {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) : θOf x ∈ Ioo 0 π`.
